item.title: Hahamusu Gaiden ~Suishou no Joou Delfina~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: bootUP!
  • 発売日: 2023-12-22
  • スコア: 7.67/10 (53 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ははむす外伝 ～水晶の女王デルフィーナ～
  • 英語名: Hahamusu Gaiden Suishou no Joou Delfina

あらすじ

In the Kingdom of Lindbaum Linica, located southeast of Central Lutina, the royal capital of Rydner, the Lindbaum family reigns supreme. Despite being a small nation, they have remained fiercely loyal to Rydner since its founding, producing numerous high-ranking government officials and ministers. The story’s heroine, Delphina Lindbaum, ascends to the throne at a young age after her sickly father’s passing.

item.title: Hahamusu ~Ochibure Kizoku no Haha to Musume~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: bootUP!
  • 発売日: 2022-05-27
  • スコア: 7.8/10 (83 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ははむす ～落ちぶれ貴族の母と娘～
  • 英語名: Hahamusu Ochibure Kizoku no Haha to Musume

あらすじ

“Please look, Mother. The town, our town, is burning.”

“Why is this happening… Oh, I’m sorry. While the city you cherished, Glia, is being set ablaze, all I can do is watch…”

A woman with beautiful silver hair, likely a mother and daughter, gazes from the mansion window at the city being set on fire and the repeated looting by the invading forces. In just three days, the soldiers of the former Goras Kingdom, now turned enemies, approach the mansion while engaging in arson.

item.title: Hani Tsuma
item.description:

  • ブランド: bootUP!

  • スコア: 7.540000000000001/10 (76 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はにつま
  • 英語名: Hani Tsuma

あらすじ

The executive position of Kirishima heavy industries has been passed down through the Akatsuki household for generations. As the only son of the Akatsuki household, Hibiki was obligated to inherit the position under the strict guidance of his father Raiden. Even though there was great hope placed upon his shoulders, he felt that it was only a burden. While he dutifully followed orders as a kid, he grew more rebellious against his father as the years passed. When it was time for him to change schools, he left his home in Tokyo for the far-away city of Nishiro to attend Narumi Gakuen and live at the Akatsuki household’s villa Kagura-tei there.

item.title: Aneimo Neo ~Second Sisters~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: bootUP!
  • 発売日: 2012-11-30
  • スコア: 7.12/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あねいもNeo Second Sisters
  • 英語名: Aneimo Neo Second Sisters

あらすじ

A full remake of Puchi Pajamas’ (now bootUP!) 2004 title Aneimo, with different characters and a similar scenario.

Shirou lives with his adopted mother Sakura and her daughters Mai and Nana ever since his parents’ deaths 7 years ago. At first he didn’t feel at ease being with a new family, but Sakura loved him as if he was her own son, so his worries were soon eased. After a few years, his adopted father died in a plane crash. Even with the loss of the central pillar of the family, Sakura continued to steadfastly support them. Now, he lives happily together with his non-blood related family.
